hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT NOR firmware FIT kernel #30
inputs.revision: Written at firmware offset 0x20000; flash verification passed. A subsequent normal boot reached the configured network path; runtime kernel version was not read.

inputs.name: LittleFS network root for kernel #30
inputs.revision: 10 MiB at offset 0x600000; flash verification passed; normal boot reached the configured network startup.

inputs.name: Strict SAE profile
inputs.revision: Required PMF configured locally; profile identifiers and credentials omitted.

inputs.name: EmberBSD connected-scan and roam probe script
inputs.revision: OS main commit aa4956cac18dbc1b9666f1bf3231e602f912a660; uploaded script SHA-256 f944252627e7b8f12025d51196a9e95aa88588aebfa33ccb34493f8b8cd8f285.

scenario: During a live probe after normal boot on one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify the strict-SAE baseline, one connected scan with baseline continuity, and one requested roam to a fresh compatible alternate.
expected: Normal boot reaches the configured network; strict SAE is completed before and through the connected scan; an accepted roam completes a new authorized association on the requested alternate.
observed: The kernel #30 FIT and its 10 MiB LittleFS root were written with flash verification. A subsequent normal boot reached the configured rc/network path; the runtime kernel version was not read. Strict SAE reported WPA_COMPLETED with IPv4. Baseline, scan_end and pre-roam status snapshots retained the same BSSID and security; no disconnect was observed during the connected scan. A fresh compatible alternate with SAE, PMF capability and SAE-H2E indicators was selected. The supplicant accepted ROAM. The first join returned error 0/current, followed by disconnect reason 201 (ESP-IDF WIFI_REASON_NO_AP_FOUND). A subsequent SAE build/parse and association completed, and the port returned to its authorized state on the original baseline BSSID. The requested alternate was not reached; no after-roam status was recorded and the probe ended FAIL roam_not_completed. No EBUSY or ESTALE was observed. The probe did not query mDNS, DNS or gateway reachability after the failed roam.

measurements.name: alternate-bssid-reached

limits: One operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample and one bounded run after writing the kernel #30 image pair; runtime kernel version was not read, and other revisions are not established.
The connected scan preserved sampled baseline state between scan markers in this run; this does not establish general connected-scan reliability.
ROAM control acceptance and later authorized recovery did not establish a transition to the requested alternate BSSID; recovery ended on the original baseline BSSID.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior were not validated.
mDNS network response, post-roam DNS and gateway reachability were not checked in this run.
WPA2-PSK and gateway reachability were verified in earlier bounded runs; those results are not measurements from kernel #30.
No forged-frame protection, throughput, or sustained-reliability test was completed.
